item.title: Trump offers US insurance, naval escorts as Hormuz crisis lifts oil prices
item.description: Oil and gas prices climbed sharply after escalating conflict involving Iran stoked fears of disruption to the Strait of Hormuz, one of the world’s most important energy corridors, through which roughly 20 per cent of global oil and gas supplies pass.

item.title: Sensex and Nifty tumble as oil surge and Middle East tensions rattle markets
item.description: Indian equity benchmarks opened sharply lower on Wednesday, extending recent losses as escalating tensions in the Middle East and a spike in crude oil prices unsettled global investors and dampened risk appetite.

item.title: European LNG cargo diverts to Asia as gas prices soar, Hormuz traffic dwindles
item.description: A liquefied natural gas (LNG) tanker initially bound for Europe has altered its route and is now heading towards Asia after a sharp jump in global gas prices, underlining the growing rivalry between the two regions for energy supplies.

item.title: Rupee hits record low as oil surge and Iran tensions unsettle markets
item.description: The Indian rupee plunged to a record low in early trading on Wednesday as soaring crude oil prices and escalating tensions between the United States and Iran dampened investor confidence.

item.title: Drone strike near US consulate in Dubai sparks fire as regional tensions escalate
item.description: A drone strike close to the United States consulate in Dubai triggered a fire late on Tuesday night, as hostilities intensified across the Middle East with reported attacks on American diplomatic facilities.

item.title: India sets up control room as West Asia conflict escalates
item.description: India has established a dedicated control room in New Delhi to assist its citizens as tensions in West Asia deepen following escalating military exchanges between the United States, Israel and Iran.

item.title: Russia and China condemn US-Israeli strikes on Iran, call for ceasefire
item.description: Russia, China raise diplomatic voices against US-Israeli attacks on Iran

item.title: India plans 58 repatriation flights as Gulf airspace closures disrupt travel
item.description: Indian airlines are set to operate 58 flights on Wednesday to bring home passengers stranded in Gulf countries, as much of Middle Eastern airspace remains closed or restricted amid escalating conflict involving the United States, Israel and Iran.

item.title: US could lose the war and why Trump will send troops to invade Iran
item.description: Professor Jiang Xuequin says the US would lose to Iran, arguing America’s Cold War-era military is costly, sluggish and ill-suited to modern conflict, giving Tehran the edge
